verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS platform with public API docs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis. The probe returned HTTP 404 for docs.ledgy.com/llms.txt, and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. The OAuth discovery metadata endpoint is an authentication feature, not agent docs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
